meaning: Private RLDX_1 evaluation contract; this file is intentionally separate from the benchmark-wide capability whitelist.

native_contract.action: RLDX emits 38 named upper-body joint targets. The audited EgoVLA bridge scatters them into an absolute joint-position target of shape [num_envs, 50] and preserves the current 12-dimensional leg qpos.
native_contract.projection: scatter 38 controlled arm/hand joints into audited H1 Inspire indices; preserve the 12 uncontrolled leg joints from the current qpos

RLDX_1.notes: Private RLDX-1 H1 Inspire adapter. Requires the selected private root, four-import origin gate, and checkpoint/runtime preflight.
